v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: Blessed are all * they that fear the Lord. ‡
Let them all be confounded * who hate Sion.

text.la: De profúndis * clamávi ad te, Dómine. ‡
text.en: Out of the depths * I have cried to thee, O Lord. ‡

text.la: Dómine, * non est exaltátum cor meum. ‡
text.en: O Lord * my heart is not exalted. ‡

text.la: Elégit Dóminus * Sion in habitatiónem sibi.
text.en: The Lord hath chosen * Sion for his dwelling.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui invéntus est sine mácula, et qui post aurum non ábiit, nec sperávit in pecúnia et thesáuris. Quis est hic, et laudábimus eum? fecit enim mirabília in vita sua.
text.en: Blessed is the rich man that is found without blemish: and that hath not gone after gold, nor put his trust in money nor in treasures. Who is he, and we will praise him? for he hath done wonderful things in his life.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: O Doctor óptime, * Ecclésiæ sanctæ lumen, beáte Laurénti, divínæ legis amátor, deprecáre pro nobis Fílium Dei.
text.en: O right excellent Teacher * Light of the Holy Church, Lawrence, blessed lover of the Divine Law, pray for us to the Son of God.

text.la: Deus, qui ad árdua quæque pro nóminis tui glória et animárum salúte beáto Lauréntio, Confessóri tuo atque Doctóri, spíritum sapiéntiæ et fortitúdinis contulísti: da nobis in eódem spíritu et agénda cognóscere; et cógnita, eius intercessióne, perfícere.
text.en: O Lord, you conferred the spirit of wisdom and fortitude on St. Lawrence, Confessor and teacher of faith, to help him perform difficult tasks for the glory of Your name and for the salvation of souls. At his intercession grant us by the same Spirit the grace to know what we ought to do and the courage to do it.

office.title: S. Laurentii a Brundusio Confessoris et Ecclesiæ Doctoris
